2_typography.monospace_font: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Consolas, monospace

hierarchy.title: 72px, bold, tracking -0.02em
hierarchy.subtitles: 28px, medium, high legibility on dark scrim

3_camera_grammar.lenses: 35mm cinema prime (wide environmental), 50mm (subject focus), 85mm macro (tactile hardware)
3_camera_grammar.movement: Slow, restrained linear dolly in/out; slow horizontal tracking; strictly zero shaky-cam or handheld jitter
3_camera_grammar.framing: Rule of thirds, deep negative space on terminal displays, motivated screen glow illuminating foreground desk textures

4_lighting.motivated_source: Cool 6500K monitor backlight reflecting off matte aluminum desk surfaces and dark glass
4_lighting.secondary_fill: Warm 3000K low-intensity practical desk lamp in background out of focus
4_lighting.shadow_profile: Deep, soft cinematic shadows, high dynamic range without clipped blacks

5_materials_and_textures.hardware: Anodized aluminum, matte PBT keycaps, braided black cables, brushed titanium bezels
5_materials_and_textures.environment: Acoustic wall panels, polished concrete or dark walnut studio surfaces

6_motion_rules.transitions: Clean hard cuts on audio beats, 8-frame linear dissolves, zero 3D page curls or stylized wipes
6_motion_rules.easing: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for UI overlays, linear smooth drift for camera moves

7_motion_graphics_standards.tool: Remotion React components for all charts, stats, tables, timelines, and UI screens
7_motion_graphics_standards.verification_badge: All unverified claims explicitly watermarked with [VERIFY // ASTRA LAUNCH CLAIM]
7_motion_graphics_standards.reconstruction_watermark: All simulated agent screen interactions watermarked with [ILLUSTRATIVE RECONSTRUCTION]

8_audio_grammar.voice: Calm, investigative documentary narrator at 135-145 WPM
8_audio_grammar.ambience: Subtle 50Hz electrical transformer hum, low subsonic drone (-24dB)
8_audio_grammar.foley: Tactile mechanical keyboard clicks, subtle terminal bell, soft whoosh on graphic transitions
8_audio_grammar.silence: Strategic 1.0s - 1.5s silence pauses preceding key conceptual questions

9_do_not_render_rules: NO glowing robotic humanoids, androids, or Terminator skulls
NO hallucinated unreadable alien typography in AI images
NO aggressive high-tempo EDM or movie-trailer braams

10_entity_tracking.agent_workspace: Standard developer desktop with Linux bash terminal, VS Code dark theme, Chromium debug browser
